title: Mean aur median mein difference?
answer: Mean = sab numbers ka total / count. Median = sorted list ka middle value. Outlier bahut bada ho, to mean zyada change ho sakta hai.
tags: mean median average statistics stats data

title: 2×2 determinant ka formula?
answer: Matrix [[a,b],[c,d]] ke liye determinant = ad−bc. Example [[2,1],[3,4]] → 8−3=5.

title: Python range() mein last value include hoti hai?
answer: Nahi. range(1,5) gives 1,2,3,4. Stop value exclude hoti hai. Iska dry run karke output check karo.

title: Independent events ka formula kya hai?
answer: A aur B independent ho to P(A∩B) = P(A)×P(B). Ye mutually exclusive se different concept hai.

title: A aur an kab use karte hain?
answer: A/an ka choice beginning sound par depend karta hai. “An honest person”, “a university” — spelling nahi, pronunciation dekho.

title: Algorithm aur flowchart kya difference?
answer: Algorithm solution ke clear steps hote hain. Flowchart un steps ko shapes aur arrows se visually represent karta hai.

title: Dependent clause kaise pehchane?
answer: Aksar although, because, when se start hota hai aur akela complete thought nahi deta. Example: “Because it rained...”

title: Union vs intersection?
answer: Union = dono sets ke all unique elements. Intersection = dono sets ke common elements. A={1,2}, B={2,3}: union={1,2,3}, intersection={2}.
